long_description:
🚨 Atlanta, are you ready? 🎉

SAVE THE DATE! 💃🕺

Join us for the 3rd Annual Bollywood Garba Night, presented by Vee Events & KG-Unplugged! 

For the third consecutive year, we’re bringing you Atlanta’s sold-out celebration featuring:

✨ The perfect mix of Bollywood beats & traditional Garba

🍽️ Mouthwatering food

🛍️ Shopping vendors

🎶 High-energy music & dancing

🎉 And so much more!

📅 Friday, October 16

📍 Astro Celebrations, Windermere Pkwy

Gather your family and friends and get ready for an unforgettable night of music, dance, food, and festive fun. Mark your calendars—this is one event you won’t want to miss!

🎟️ Tickets and more details coming soon!
